query: How will we quantify OCR and computer-vision precision, recall, false positive/negative rates on a held-out labelled set, and which methods (SIMEX, bootstrap, Monte Carlo) will we use to propagate these errors into SEs and p-values?

response.query: How will we quantify OCR and computer-vision precision, recall, false positive/negative rates on a held-out labelled set, and which methods (SIMEX, bootstrap, Monte Carlo) will we use to propagate these errors into SEs and p-values?
response.answer: Precision, recall, false positive/negative rates for OCR and computer vision are quantified using confusion matrix metrics on a held-out labelled set. Bootstrap or Monte Carlo methods will propagate these errors into standard errors and p-values.
